name: HandX Innovation
summary: HandX Innovation is a Wuhan developer of humanoid robots, dexterous hands and tactile sensing technology. The company’s products include the Yuanyou humanoid, moxibustion robots, assistive hands, and sensing devices. It combines robot perception and movement-control research with commercialization for everyday assistance and industrial support.
